title: Environment — high mid (~7.5)
notes: Resourceful speaker; flexible grammar; labels around 7.5.

turns.text: What environmental issues concern people in your area?
Air quality is the main concern. During winter, haze from heating and traffic makes outdoor exercise less appealing, so local groups push for cleaner public transport.
Do individuals or governments have more responsibility?
Both matter, but governments set the incentives. If recycling is inconvenient, even motivated citizens give up; subsidies for electric buses change behaviour faster than posters alone.
Somewhat. I carry a reusable bottle and I avoid food delivery when I can cook. These are small steps, yet they keep the issue visible in daily life rather than abstract news.
